actions.title: Device readiness
actions.description: Read-only device/interface diagnostics.
actions.blocker: New APK handset lifecycle, receive and recovery qualification pending.

actions.title: Privacy preflight
actions.description: Read-only privacy facts; active transmission requires current passing privileged checks.
actions.blocker: Unknown or failed checks block active transmission. Handset qualification pending.

actions.title: Prepare private lab
actions.description: Save settings, disable cellular/Bluetooth, enable airplane mode and install verified IP egress locks. Explicit restore required.
actions.blocker: Requires bounded privileged Android commands. Unknown facts remain blocked; handset qualification pending.

actions.title: Restore privacy settings
actions.description: Restore the separately journaled connectivity settings and remove owned IP egress locks; radio firmware recovery remains separate.
actions.blocker: Requires bounded privileged Android commands. Unknown facts remain blocked; handset qualification pending.

actions.title: Privacy settings status
actions.description: Read current privacy settings and recovery journal. Manual fallback: airplane mode on, cellular/Bluetooth off, no IP egress, randomized local WLAN address.
actions.blocker: Requires bounded privileged Android commands. Unknown facts remain blocked; handset qualification pending.

actions.title: Passive capture
actions.description: Bounded passive capture with restored radio before analysis.
actions.blocker: New APK handset lifecycle, receive and recovery qualification pending.

actions.title: Deauth selected client
actions.description: One explicit request to the selected AP/client and frequency; no automatic retry. Saved and imported targets are usable. Current privileged privacy and channel checks apply.
actions.blocker: New APK handset lifecycle, receive and recovery qualification pending.

actions.title: Restore Wi-Fi
actions.description: Reconcile shared radio recovery state.
actions.blocker: New APK handset lifecycle, receive and recovery qualification pending.

actions.title: Analyze PCAP
actions.description: Offline protocol evidence; no transmission.
actions.blocker: Bundled decoder availability required.

actions.title: WPS · Pixie Dust
actions.description: Collect one exchange on the internal radio or import one, run Pixiewps locally and save verified results in Vault.
actions.blocker: Live collection and credential retrieval are experimental until qualified on this phone and AP; a recovered PIN is not a network password.

actions.title: Client isolation experiment
actions.description: Bounded ordinary-socket nonce proof between controlled endpoints.
actions.blocker: Topology and route evidence required before direct-versus-forwarded classification.

actions.title: Management TX/RX experiment
actions.description: Correlate request cookie, response and independent receive evidence.
actions.blocker: No general injection proof; previous peer retry failed.

actions.title: PMF experiment
actions.description: Separate advertised policy from negotiated protection.
actions.blocker: Association transcript and authorized independent receiver required.

actions.title: SoftAP experiment
actions.description: Observe controlled AP lifecycle, association and restore.
actions.blocker: Firmware/driver capability and recovery not qualified.

actions.title: MLO experiment
actions.description: Decode advertised links without claiming negotiated multi-link operation.
actions.blocker: Negotiated link evidence and supported firmware path absent.

actions.title: Firmware static audit
actions.description: Pinned static artifact audit, no patching or loading.
actions.blocker: ROM omissions and runtime context predicates unresolved.

actions.title: WPS PIN / push-button enrollment
actions.description: Enroll with a known PIN or push-button window and save verified credentials in the vault.
actions.blocker: Managed-mode WPS transport, cancellation, expiry and credential handoff are not implemented or qualified in this app.

actions.title: Live WPS PIN audit
actions.description: Live WPS exchange collection, PIN enrollment and lockout assessment. Imported-exchange analysis is available separately under WPS / Pixie Dust.
actions.blocker: No working WPS exchange collector or recovery workflow on this internal radio. Target susceptibility and recovery remain unproven.

actions.title: WPA / WPA2 password audit
actions.description: Check a captured exchange against a user-supplied wordlist; save a verified result to the vault.
actions.blocker: The app captures and separates exchanges but has no integrated password-testing backend. A capture alone does not recover a password; WPA3 SAE is not equivalent to a WPA2 dictionary check.

actions.title: PMKID assessment
actions.description: Identify a suitable PMKID exchange and evaluate whether offline password verification applies.
actions.blocker: A PMKID workflow and supported target configuration have not been qualified. This is not a universal clientless recovery method.

actions.title: WEP IV collection / analysis
actions.description: Legacy WEP capture analysis and key-recovery workflow.
actions.blocker: No WEP workflow is integrated. Replay and IV-generation modes additionally require a working injection path.

actions.title: Controlled AP / evil-twin comparison
actions.description: Compare association, reconnection and security policy against a controlled AP.
actions.blocker: SoftAP lifecycle, configuration, station/AP concurrency and recovery need qualification before this workflow can run.

actions.title: AP availability / authentication load
actions.description: Measure an AP’s behavior under a bounded availability test, with recovery observations.
actions.blocker: Authentication/frame-generation paths and bounded workload controls are not implemented. Directed client deauth does not establish these capabilities.

actions.title: Beacon / probe frame experiments
actions.description: Controlled discovery-frame generation and response comparison.
actions.blocker: General monitor injection has not been demonstrated on this build. The working managed deauth path cannot be assumed to transmit other frame families.
